## Summary
- Add `SecretsManager` module that prioritizes Airflow Connections over environment variables
- Auto-configure connections on Airflow startup via `init-connections.sh`

## Connections Configured
| Connection ID | Type | Purpose |
|--------------|------|---------|
| `postgres_weather` | postgres | Weather database |
| `minio_datalake` | aws | Data lake storage |
| `openweather_api` | http | OpenWeatherMap API |
| `aemet_api` | http | AEMET Spanish Met Agency |
| `openmeteo_api` | http | Open-Meteo API |
| `github_api` | http | GitHub token |

## Files Changed
- `src/weather_config/secrets_manager.py` - New centralized secrets management
- `docker/airflow/init-connections.sh` - Connection initialization script
- `docker-compose.yml` - Mount init script
- `src/weather_config/*.py` - Updated to use SecretsManager

## Test plan
- [ ] Verify imports work: `python -c "from weather_config.secrets_manager import SecretsManager"`
- [ ] Verify Airflow connections created on container startup
- [ ] Verify fallback to env vars works outside Airflow context
